scenarios.name: opponent-spell-taxed-during-your-turn
scenarios.why: During seat 0's turn, seat 1's Lightning Bolt is outside its controller's turn and costs three additional generic mana; three red alone is insufficient.

scenarios.name: opponent-pays-full-three-generic-tax
scenarios.why: The same opponent's spell is offered when its controller has the red mana plus all three generic mana required by the Grid.

scenarios.name: controller-spell-during-own-turn-not-taxed
scenarios.why: A spell costs no extra mana during its controller's turn. Seat 0 can cast its Bolt for its printed red cost despite controlling the Grid.
